text: APPROVE. The refactor splits the method into `TryList`, `ReadEntries` and `EnqueueSubdirectories` with identical control flow (unlisted directories are recorded in `unread`, the max-files break is unchanged, and subdirectories are enqueued regardless). Each new method scores well under 15 and the CHA0004 pragma still covers all of the catch blocks. I could only see the diff, so I have not confirmed that `maxFiles` is an `int` or that `wanted` is a `Func<string, bool>`, and I did not run a build.
